name: setup_dev_venv
description: Local/dev-testing only -- never relevant to a real production install. Creates (or resets) a .venv inside this plugin's own directory and installs requirements.txt into it, isolating its Python dependencies from every other plugin sharing this same development machine/user. Production never needs this: each plugin there gets its own dedicated OS user instead, which already isolates it without a venv. Once created, both main.py and install.sh pick .venv up automatically on every subsequent run/install, with no further configuration. Call this BEFORE install_generated_plugin, not after -- the host runs install.sh (which checks for .venv) as part of that call's own install step, and the check only helps if .venv already exists by the time the host gets there.

location.description: The subdirectory name under the server's plugin output root -- the same 'location' generate_plugin_scaffold/install_generated_plugin use.
